title: Scope, lifetime, storage duration and linkage
learningObjectives: Explain the concept and its C language rules.
Trace the example and explain data flow.
Identify common errors and boundary conditions.
Apply the concept in a small tested program.

understand.concept: Scope describes where an identifier can be used in source code. Storage duration describes how long an object's storage exists. Linkage describes whether declarations in different scopes or translation units refer to the same entity. These are distinct properties.
understand.whyItMatters: Confusing scope with lifetime or linkage causes bugs in global state, local objects, static variables and multi-file programs.
understand.analogy: Treat a function or pointer operation as an explicit contract between caller and callee.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy does not replace C's formal rules for types, object lifetime, scope and linkage.

explain.narrative:
Scope describes where an identifier can be used in source code. Storage duration describes how long an object's storage exists. Linkage describes whether declarations in different scopes or translation units refer to the same entity. These are distinct properties.

When applying this concept, check declared types, preconditions, object lifetime and all control-flow paths. Compile with warnings enabled and test both typical and boundary inputs.

examples.title: Focused C example
examples.explanation: The variable next has block scope but static storage duration. Its value persists between calls even though its name is visible only inside next_id.

practise.guidedTask: Compare an automatic local variable with the static local variable in this example.
practise.independentTask: Create a function with a static call counter and explain its scope and storage duration.
hints: A block-scope identifier can designate an object with static storage duration.
extern declarations and external linkage need consistent declarations across translation units.
Prefer limited scope and avoid unnecessary mutable global state.
